scope: offline temporary-state simulation and static ordering audit only; no live service mutation, checkpoint access, result collection, training-log inspection, scheduling, or model execution

simulation.method: invoke the frozen finalize function twelve times against temporary program/result/target/analysis/transition paths while replacing only external systemd, collector, validator, git, and scheduling effects with recording doubles

training: initialize runtime, data, model, restore state, tracking, and execution
run every optimizer and validation/checkpoint step
finally finish any remaining tracking and destroy the distributed process group
finalization: wait on the training MainPID through pidfd
validate the frozen automation hashes and clean repository
derive and check the expected completed run
collect and validate the final checkpoint/result
lock the target only after control six or analyze only after candidate six
atomically update the program and write the transition
commit the result/program/transition and target or analysis when applicable
schedule the exact next cell after a 15-minute cooldown
launch: validate automation, repository, program, live GPU/mount/memory/output gates
install the exact final-summary PathExists watcher
replace the launcher process with the frozen training command

fail_closed_behavior.collection_or_validation_failure: path trigger is already disabled; no commit, schedule, skip, or automatic retry follows
fail_closed_behavior.schedule_failure_after_commit: the accepted result remains committed but the chain stops before the next launch
fail_closed_behavior.unexpected_output_before_launch: live gate fails before installing a watcher or executing training
fail_closed_behavior.dirty_repository: finalization or launch stops before state mutation
fail_closed_behavior.duplicate_or_out_of_order_event: count-derived expected-run check rejects it before collection

residual_hardening.current_behavior: pidfd waits for process exit, but the transition does not record systemd Result, ExecMainStatus, invocation ID, or exit timestamp
residual_hardening.current_risk: run_summary is written only after successful steps and tracking finish, so the collector validates the scientific artifact; a post-summary distributed cleanup failure could still leave terminal service provenance absent
residual_hardening.future_change: in a post-sequence automation version, record immutable terminal unit properties and explicitly disposition cleanup-only nonzero exits

residual_hardening.current_behavior: launch requires both count-derived expected_next and stored next_run, while finalize rechecks only count-derived expected_next
residual_hardening.current_risk: the prior launch and program validator establish the correct next_run; a clean committed program mutation during a live cell could be overwritten rather than rejected
residual_hardening.future_change: in a post-sequence automation version, require stored next_run to equal the completed run before collection

residual_hardening.current_behavior: unit command construction and individual helpers are covered, but the twelve-cell audit replaces external systemd/git/collector effects with recording doubles
residual_hardening.current_risk: the simulation proves state transitions, not a twelve-job systemd integration on disposable units
residual_hardening.future_change: add short disposable systemd integration fixtures after the current sequence, without GPU or scientific paths

decision.next_action: leave v2 byte-identical through the active sequence; accept only final-summary events, and defer the two runner changes plus disposable systemd integration coverage to a post-sequence automation version

verification.command: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv-paper1-cpu uv run --extra cpu pytest tests/test_paper_finalist_continue.py -q

non_claims: recording doubles prove systemd integration behavior
a path event alone proves training-service success
the residual hardening items justify mutating the active frozen runner
the simulation authorizes retry, skipping, branching, promotion, or release
this audit contains or inspects finalist model results
